verdict.rationale: Adyen documents Adyen-generated reports for bookkeeping/reconciliation and provides webhooks for platform-level event tracking, which supports a platform's ability to build seller-facing statements/exports. However, there is no evidence of a self-serve seller-facing statement portal, per-seller payout reconciliation UI, or bookkeeper-ready export flow that sellers can access without the platform operator building and mediating it themselves. Missing for 10: seller-facing self-serve statement/export UI, evidence of per-seller reconciliation reports, evidence of a bookkeeper-consumable export format, and independent confirmation that ops teams avoid manual intervention.
